title: Single-cell temporal transcriptomics of the human cell cycle

about.name: GEO GSE146773: Single-cell temporal transcriptomics of the human cell cycle
about.quote: A total of 1,152 single U2OS FUCCI cells were sorted by FACS, and RNA-Seq was collected for each cell using SMART-seq2 chemistry.
about.label: NCBI GEO

here: Here: 400 of the cells, picked evenly along the authors’ FUCCI pseudotime, as their two log reporter intensities (A) and as the first 5 principal components of the 500 most variable genes (B).

mahdessian2021.text: Mahdessian D, Cesnik AJ, Gnann C, et al. (2021). Spatiotemporal dissection of the cell cycle with single-cell proteogenomics. Nature 590:649–654.
